channel.title: SecurityWizardry Vulnerability Radar (RMFconsultoria)
channel.description: Alertas de vulnerabilidade (CVSS) - fonte NVD (fallback quando o SecurityWizardry está bloqueado) - RMFconsultoria

item.title: CVE-2026-123601 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3 | Hickory DNS hickory-proto 0.25.0 through 0.26.0-alpha.1 and hickory-net 0.26.0-beta.1 before 0.26.2 invert the relational operators in the wrap-around branch of find_covering_record() in nsec3.rs, so the last NSEC3 record in a zone's hash ring covers every hash except its owner. Attackers able to inject DNS responses can replay that NSEC3 record and its RRSIG to forge DNSSEC-validated negative responses denying legitimate names.

item.title: CVE-2026-123602 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2 | The Hickory DNS recursor in all versions of hickory-recursor and in hickory-resolver 0.26.0-beta.1 before 0.26.2 (recursor feature) is vulnerable to ghost domain names attacks because it reuses child-side apex NS RRsets cached from zone NS queries for iterative resolution. By repeatedly querying a zone's NS records, an attacker keeps the stale RRset cached indefinitely, letting name servers whose delegation the parent revoked keep answering for the zone.

item.title: CVE-2026-123603 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | hickory-proto and hickory-resolver 0.26.0 before 0.26.2, hickory-server 0.25.0-alpha.1 before 0.26.2, and hickory-recursor 0.25.0-alpha.3 through 0.26.0-alpha.1 fail to canonicalize IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses when checking deny_answers, deny_server, or AccessControlSet rules. Attackers can use IPv4-mapped addresses to evade answer filtering, trigger queries to denied nameservers, or reach hickory-server library deployments on dual-stack IPv6 sockets from denied clients.

item.title: CVE-2026-123604 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Hickory DNS hickory-resolver 0.26.0-beta.1 before 0.26.2 contains an unbounded retry loop in NameServerPool::try_send, which re-queues truncated (TC) responses without checking the answering transport or counting iterations. A malicious authoritative server returning TC=1 on every transport keeps the resolver spinning on a persistent TCP connection until the 5-second request deadline expires, causing resource exhaustion.

item.title: CVE-2026-123605 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Hickory DNS hickory-proto 0.1 through 0.25.0-alpha.3 and hickory-net before 0.26.2 contain a DNSSEC validation bypass because the validator verifies an RRSIG against the DNSKEY of whatever name appears in its Signer's Name field without checking that this name is the zone containing the RRset. Attackers controlling any secure zone can produce valid signatures over arbitrary records in unrelated zones, which resolvers, recursors, and clients using DnssecDnsHandle accept as authenticated.

item.title: CVE-2026-123606 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | The hickory-dns recursor in hickory-recursor 0.25.0-alpha.3 through 0.25.2 and hickory-resolver 0.26.0-alpha.1 before 0.26.2 iterates every out-of-bailiwick NS target lacking glue in a referral without any per-query work budget. Remote attackers can serve such referrals to force A and AAAA lookups per target, amplifying traffic against remote servers or exhausting recursor resources.

item.title: CVE-2026-123607 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Hickory DNS hickory-proto 0.25.0-alpha.3 through 0.25.2 and hickory-net before 0.26.1 contain an unbounded loop vulnerability in DnssecDnsHandle NSEC3 closest-encloser proof validation when the SOA owner is not an ancestor of the QNAME. Upstream attackers can return NoData or NXDomain responses with a cross-zone SOA record to panic debug builds or exhaust memory in release builds.

item.title: CVE-2026-123608 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Hickory DNS hickory-proto from 0.3.1 before 0.26.1 contains a denial of service vulnerability in BinEncoder that allows remote attackers to exhaust CPU through quadratic-time name compression. Attackers can send malicious DNS messages with many records that add many candidate labels and trigger repeated linear scans during encoding, amplifying CPU exhaustion.

item.title: CVE-2026-123609 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 4.1
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 4.1 | Rustls before 0.23.46 and 0.24.0-dev.1 before 0.24.0-dev.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability where derived Debug formatting of client session values exposes secret key material. Custom ClientSessionStore implementations that log Tls12ClientSessionValue or Tls13ClientSessionValue can leak TLS 1.2 master secrets or TLS 1.3 resumption PSKs to log readers.

item.title: CVE-2026-123610 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | rustls before 0.23.46 contains an uncontrolled memory allocation flaw in its optional Brotli certificate decompression, which limits decompressed output size but accepts an input-selected large history window. Malicious peers can send a certificate with a five-byte Brotli header requesting up to 1 GiB before authentication, aborting Brotli-enabled clients or client-authenticating servers whose allocator cannot satisfy the request.

item.title: CVE-2026-123611 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | rustls before 0.23.46 contains a key exchange downgrade vulnerability that allows network attackers to poison the per-server-name key-exchange group record via an unauthenticated ServerHello. Attackers can answer one connection with a ServerHello selecting X25519, causing later ClientHellos to send only classical shares and lose post-quantum confidentiality.

item.title: CVE-2026-123612 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 4.6
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 4.6 | rustls 0.23.44 and 0.23.45 contain an information disclosure vulnerability that sends application data buffered before the handshake completes to the client-facing server when Encrypted Client Hello is rejected. Because start_traffic() queues plaintext from ClientConnection::writer() before sending the ech_required alert, the authenticated public_name server receives data intended for the inner server.

item.title: CVE-2026-123613 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | Rustls from 0.23.13 before 0.23.45 accepts TLS 1.3 handshake messages at the wrong encryption level when they follow a key-changing message in the same record, because Deframer::aligned does not enforce RFC 8446 record-boundary alignment. A peer or on-path attacker can pack a plaintext EncryptedExtensions with the ServerHello, which rustls accepts unencrypted.

item.title: CVE-2026-123614 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3 | imgproxy from 4.0.0 before 4.0.16 contains an integer overflow in the ICO loader that allows remote attackers to trigger a heap buffer overflow via a crafted data_size value. Attackers can submit a crafted ICO image whose data_size wraps the allocation in vips/icoload.c, corrupting heap memory to crash the process or achieve code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-123615 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | imgproxy 3.3.0 before 4.0.17 contains an out-of-bounds heap read and write in the ICO loader's BMP header reconstruction (vips_foreign_load_ico_header in vips/icoload.c) when an ICO entry declares a tiny data size, causing unvalidated header fields to be read and written past the allocated buffer. Unauthenticated remote attackers can supply a crafted ICO image to corrupt adjacent heap chunk metadata, triggering a glibc abort that crashes the worker.

item.title: CVE-2026-123616 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | imgproxy from 3.3.0 before 4.0.16 contains an unbounded memory allocation vulnerability in the ICO loader that fails to validate the data_size field. Attackers can supply a crafted 23-byte ICO file declaring a ~4GB data_size to trigger memory exhaustion and worker crashes without authentication.

item.title: CVE-2026-124422 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | SunEditor from 3.0.0 before 3.4.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in html.clean() that rebuilds iframes from data-se-iframe-holder-attrs JSON without filtering srcdoc or uppercase SRC keys. Attackers can inject crafted HTML through paste, html.set, or html.insert to execute script in the host page origin when victims load or paste the content.

item.title: CVE-2026-114713 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.6
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.6 | The labeled-response module in UnrealIRCd 6.0.0 before 6.2.7.1 does not escape the IRCv3 "label" message tag when echoing it into replies, which allows any user on a network with two or more linked servers to inject server-to-server commands that are executed with server authority.

item.title: CVE-2026-103303 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Turisbook Booking System WordPress plugin through 1.3.8 does not have authorisation and CSRF checks when saving its settings, and does not sanitise and escape one of them before outputting it in an admin page, allowing unauthenticated users to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks against administrators.

item.title: CVE-2026-103375 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Antom Payments WordPress plugin through 2.0.11 does not perform any ownership or authorisation check before returning an order's confirmation link, which contains its secret key, to unauthenticated visitors, allowing attackers to view any customer's order details, including name, address, phone number and email.

item.title: CVE-2026-104307 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The BackUpWordPress plugin before 3.15 does not perform a capability or nonce check on an AJAX action that cleans up its backup directory, allowing any authenticated user (Subscriber and above) to delete the BackUpWordPress plugin before 3.15's backup protection and working files, removing download protection from stored backups and disrupting in-progress backups.

item.title: CVE-2026-104337 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Razorpay for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 4.8.9 does not verify ownership of an order before returning a coupon discount computed against that order, allowing unauthenticated attackers to disclose the monetary value of arbitrary customer orders by enumerating order IDs.

item.title: CVE-2026-104338 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Razorpay for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 4.8.9 does not perform an authorization check on one of its REST routes and derives the acting user's identity from an unauthenticated request parameter, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to cause the request to execute as an arbitrary user account for the duration of the request. Exploitation additionally requires a specific coupon Razorpay for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 4.8.9 to be active on the site.

item.title: CVE-2026-104639 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Razorpay for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 4.8.9 does not sanitize and escape a value derived from an incoming webhook request before using it in a SQL query, allowing users able to obtain the webhook secret (administrators) to perform SQL injection attacks.

item.title: CVE-2026-105970 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Thanh Toán Quét Mã QR Code Tự Động WordPress plugin through 2.0.1 does not properly verify the authenticity of incoming bank-transfer payment notifications on a default installation, allowing unauthenticated attackers to mark arbitrary WooCommerce orders as paid.

item.title: CVE-2026-106015 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Ecommerce Affiliate WordPress plugin through 1.0.0 does not restrict one-time password issuance and verification to the legitimate account owner, nor limit verification attempts, allowing unauthenticated attackers to take over any account, including administrators.

item.title: CVE-2026-109925 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Productive Commerce WordPress plugin before 1.1.54 does not sanitise and escape a parameter before using it in a SQL statement, allowing unauthenticated attackers to perform SQL injection attacks.

item.title: CVE-2026-110132 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Sync Post With Other Site WordPress plugin before 1.9.4 does not properly authorize a content-management action for post types other than pages, allowing users with Contributor-level access or above to create and modify arbitrary custom post types, including reassigning content authorship.

item.title: CVE-2026-110963 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Userplace WordPress plugin through 1.2.0 does not perform authorization checks on an AJAX action available to unauthenticated users and publicly exposes the nonce that protects it, allowing unauthenticated attackers to create an administrator account or write arbitrary site options, leading to full site takeover.

item.title: CVE-2026-114432 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Contact Form 7 WordPress plugin before 6.2.4 does not validate the type or extension of files uploaded through a form file field, and a flaw in its temporary-file cleanup leaves the uploaded file on disk, allowing unauthenticated users to upload arbitrary files to the site. On a stock Debian or Ubuntu Apache configuration, which lists directory contents and maps .phar to the PHP handler, the stored file can be located and executed, leading to Remote Code Execution. On other configurations, including nginx and Apache with .htaccess overrides enabled, the issue is limited to an arbitrary file written into the uploads directory, which may still be served as active content such as HTML or SVG from the site's own origin.

item.title: CVE-2026-122060 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The WP Recipe Maker WordPress plugin before 10.9.2 does not check whether the post a recipe is embedded in is password protected before returning the recipe through its REST API and structured data output, allowing unauthenticated users to read the full content of recipes in password-protected posts.

item.title: CVE-2026-122062 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Pronamic Pay WordPress plugin before 11.1.0, Pronamic Pay doneren met Mollie WordPress plugin before 1.7.1 do not restrict access to stored form submissions through the REST API, allowing unauthenticated users to read the messages that visitors submitted through the bundled forms.

item.title: CVE-2026-122085 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Event Tickets Manager for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 1.6.0 does not perform authorisation or a valid nonce check on its ticket-transfer feature, which is available to unauthenticated users, allowing them to transfer other attendees' guest-checkout tickets to an email address of their choosing, invalidating the legitimate ticket and causing the victim's ticket PDF, which contains attendee personal data, to be sent to the attacker.

item.title: CVE-2026-85344 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The FV Flowplayer Video Player WordPress plugin before 7.5.57.7212 does not perform any authorization check on an AJAX action that carries out a site-wide content rewrite, so any authenticated user, including subscriber-level, can trigger a bulk modification of posts they should not be able to edit.

item.title: CVE-2026-96961 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Pie Register WordPress plugin through 3.8.4.15 does not perform any capability, nonce or authentication check on one of its request handlers, allowing unauthenticated attackers to reset the Pie Register WordPress plugin through 3.8.4.15's settings to their defaults (disabling registration security controls such as new-user email verification) and to destroy a Pie Register WordPress plugin through 3.8.4.15 data table.

item.title: CVE-2026-96963 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Pie Register WordPress plugin through 3.8.4.15 does not perform an authorisation check in one of its AJAX actions, allowing users with a role as low as contributor to modify existing administrator-created invitation-code records.

item.title: CVE-2026-97192 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Secure Custom Fields WordPress plugin before 6.9.8 does not re-apply its field-group location rules when persisting values submitted through the post editor save path, allowing users with contributor-level access and above to write custom fields the site restricted to administrators onto their own posts.

item.title: CVE-2026-97193 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Secure Custom Fields WordPress plugin before 6.9.8 does not verify that a user is allowed to edit the target object before writing to it during bidirectional relationship synchronization, allowing users with contributor-level access and above to add or remove a reference to their own object on arbitrary posts, users, or terms they cannot otherwise edit.

item.title: CVE-2026-97194 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Secure Custom Fields WordPress plugin before 6.9.8 does not perform a read-permission check when it renders and formats the values of its relational fields, allowing users with post-editing access (Contributor and above) to disclose the titles and non-public statuses of other users' unpublished posts.

item.title: CVE-2026-97195 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Secure Custom Fields WordPress plugin before 6.9.8 does not sanitize a persisted field definition before emitting part of it as an HTML attribute name, allowing a user able to configure its fields to store a payload that executes as JavaScript in the browser of any user who views a page rendering the affected field, which on multisite lets a site administrator who lacks the unfiltered_html capability inject script into other users' sessions.
